entities.name: Dominik Lakatoš
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Dominik Lakatoš is a Czech professional ice hockey player. He is currently playing for BK Mladá Boleslav of the Czech Extraliga (ELH). He was selected by the New York Rangers in the sixth round, 157th overall, of the 2017 NHL Entry Draft.
